title: Half brothers John, Cooney, Man and Boy in the district
summary: Arthur describes his father's other family: half brothers, three pianists and a drummer, who worked in the red light district.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How was he related to you or your father?
He was a half brother of mine, on my father's side. Now there was John, there was another brother by the name of Cooney, and there was another brother by the name of Boy.
Those are brothers of yours, not your father's?
Half brothers of mine. Of mine.
Of yours, yeah. My father's sons, on the other side, on the other half. Yeah, I see, half brother of yours.
And they had another brother I had, he was a drummer just like my daddy, half brother with me.
Yeah, I didn't know about them.

Yeah, all the other side of the family too played music. They had Cooney, John, they had Man and Boy, that was the four brothers that played music. Three of them were piano players and one was a drummer.
And they worked in the district and all of them too?

All of them worked in the district, all through those cabarets. I was a very young kid, I was a little younger than them, you see. And they all worked in the red light district and they were good musicians on my father's side. And I had another brother play music.
